# Fixture — Cloudflare's managed content block, CAPTURED VERBATIM from
# https://hospeda.com.ar/robots.txt on 2026-07-31 (HOS-369 spec §5.10).
#
# This is NOT emitted by this app. Cloudflare prepends it at the edge, ahead of
# the app's dynamic robots.txt. It is checked in so the AC-A3 guard can prove it
# detects the real production contradiction, instead of only testing the app's
# own (already consistent) output.
#
# Source: Cloudflare dashboard -> hospeda.com.ar -> AI Crawl Control -> Señales
# -> "robots.txt gestionado" toggle. It applies to EVERY hostname in the zone
# (hospeda, www, staging, api, staging-admin), not just the apex.
#
# The ~25 lines of Content Signals licence prose that Cloudflare emits above
# `# BEGIN` are elided here: they are all comments, so the parser strips them
# and they change no assertion. Everything from `# BEGIN` down is verbatim,
# including the `Allow: /` on the `*` group — an earlier hand-written version of
# this fixture omitted it and made a passing test pass for the wrong reason.
#
# Keep in sync with the live file if the managed block changes.

# BEGIN Cloudflare Managed content

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference
Allow: /

Disallow: /

Disallow: /

Disallow: /

Disallow: /
